name: What factors determine the cost of a residential interior painting project?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of a residential interior painting project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional interior painting costs depend primarily on square footage, ceiling heights, wall condition, and the level of trim or molding involved. A straightforward repaint of smooth walls with minimal prep costs substantially less than a project involving damaged drywall, heavy texture matching, or high vaulted ceilings. The scope also expands if baseboards, crown molding, doors, or window casings require detailed brushwork. Gathering room dimensions and noting existing wall damage beforehand helps produce an accurate, detailed project estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pricing depends on room size, ceiling height, trim detail, wall surface condition, and the amount of prep or drywall patching required.
